description: The line plot illustrates the change in performance, measured by the metric minFDE20, as a function of the ratio of the in-context pool size. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE20 (±)" and is on a linear scale ranging from 18 to 23. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue line), Head Tuning (orange line), FT (green line), LoRA 16 (red line), and LoRA 64 (purple line). The TrajICL line shows a decreasing trend, starting at a value just below 22 and ending at a value just above 18. The Head Tuning line starts at a value just above 22 and ends at a value just below 22. The FT line starts at a value just below 22 and ends at a value just above 21. The LoRA 16 line starts at a value just above 22 and ends at a value just below 22. The LoRA 64 line starts at a value just below 22 and ends at a value just above 21.
